name: dmengine-fumo-download-update-multi-failure
description: Mode C multi-component combined FUMO failure result: the mock sends Exec on ./ManagedObjects/FUMO/DownloadAndUpdate and serves the 291-byte two-component/three-update DP. The engine downloads it, advances FUMO state 30 -> 40 -> 60 and hands event 77 with /update//lab-fumo to the OEM handler, which reports lab result 500. The engine reports the failure through a DM session, returns to idle and never enters success state 90. The result is lab-supplied and the package is structural; no physical install is claimed.
